title: This AI game dev tool gives you free unlimited access if you can ship 2 games in 7 days
author: Sakatamd
selftext:
Wanted to share this, found it through a friend.

Sign up with an invite code, you get 7 days of full unlimited access. Ship 2 games in that week and they give you a whole extra month free.

No penalty if you don't make it. Account just drops to free tier.

If you've got game ideas sitting around, worth a shot: [Combos.fun](https://combos.fun/?utm_medium=social&utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=202604launch&utm_content=combosfun&inviteCode=RE004)

comments.author: Sakatamd
